site.name: Vu Nhat Quang Phung
site.tagline: I design and operate production-grade full-stack, cloud, and AI systems from customer requirements to continuous improvement.

paragraphs: I'm a senior software engineer focused on full-stack, backend, cloud, and AI solution engineering. I work across TypeScript / Node.js and Python, with hands-on ownership of solution architecture, Azure deployments, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and production operations.

From customer requirements and MVPs through testing, staging, production, and continuous improvement, I build maintainable systems that are secure, observable, and ready to evolve. My current focus includes LLM and agent systems, evaluation harnesses, and workflow automation.
highlights: End-to-end delivery from customer requirements to production operations
LLM, agent, and AI harness engineering with repeatable evaluation
Azure, Docker, OpenTofu, CI/CD, monitoring, and infrastructure ownership

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer - AI Solution Engineering
experience.description: Work with customers and stakeholders to turn business requirements into user-centered digital solutions. Build and operate TypeScript and PostgreSQL services on Azure with Docker, OpenTofu, GitLab CI/CD, monitoring, and production support, while developing LLM and agent applications with evaluation and hardening workflows.

Developed and operated production web platforms and backend services across React, Angular, Vue, Node.js, NestJS, and FastAPI. Built data-processing and ingestion pipelines, worked across Linux and Docker infrastructure, and coordinated two working students through a Kanban-based delivery workflow.

Automated data-processing and reporting workflows with SQL, VBA, and Microsoft SQL Server. Improved data quality through validation and standardized structures, and supported software-validation activities with structured technical documentation.
